name: Kanamonoya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood hardware shop: an opening-hours notice, a first day helping sell screws, a seasonal snow-shovel price list with a point-card bonus, a free key-copy service notice, a new-staff training comparison, a customer-troubles listening story, a trainee lesson on key replacement and basic tool use, an explainer on why a dented/scratched discount corner started, a winter-prep tool-set application guide, a column on how more DIY tool consultations changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of a hardware shop's tool-fitting craft, and a one-year hardware-wholesaler cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
